name: Layer Separation Heuristic
definition: A heuristic method to separate volume layers for multi-frame rate rendering by identifying main visual effects along a ray. It solves the problem of determining where to split raycasting from image warping to preserve depth cues.
summary: The Layer Separation Heuristic identifies optimal ray split points based on visual impact rather than depth, enabling efficient multi-layer volume rendering by separating high-quality raycasting from lower-cost warping.
